id.description: stable id, referenced by casts and by VN events (`joinScene` `name`) – `^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]*$`

name.description: display name per locale (the VN speaker plate)

color.description: CSS color (VN avatar background, speaker accents)

own_toon.description: the toon this character is the protagonist of (optional – most characters have none)

image.description: legacy single image (the last fallback; placeholder e.g. `<toon>/avatar.webp`)

affiliations.description: default groups of every persona (a persona's own `affiliations` replace them)

RegistryCharacter.description: One character of the registry. Image values are CDN paths from the CDN root (`catpope/images/characters/…`).

LocaleText.description: Text per locale: `{ de: "Kostüm", en: "Costume Design" }`.

Affiliation.description: Membership of a character (or of one of its personas) in a shared group.

StoryPoint.description: A point in a toon's story (a free reference for the editor and the story bible).

path.description: CDN path from the CDN root

CharacterArtwork.description: Character artwork that is not an expression (key visuals, turnarounds …).

label.description: appended to the name: "Cat Pope · Biker" (the regular persona needs none)

introduced.description: where the persona first appears (none = it has always been there)

affiliations.description: replaces the character's affiliations for this persona (e.g. only the biker is in the gang)

CharacterPersona.description: A different identity or role of the same being. `regular` = the base persona every character has.

id.description: `^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]*$`; `default` = no look segment in the convention path

default.description: exactly one look of a persona is the default (VN refs without `look`)

images.description: mood → view → CDN path (from the CDN root)

apose.description: the A-pose (avatar body) of this look – optional, never a fallback for other views

CharacterLook.description: An appearance of a persona (with / without helmet): its own mood set.

CharacterImage.description: One mood of a character in its three views (framings). "View" is the term in the UI (never "variant", which would be confused with looks); the keys and `VNCharacterRef.position.variant` keep their names for backwards compatibility.

path.description: CDN path from the CDN root (e.g. `catpope/avatar/mannequin.webp`, 768 × 1152)

anchors.description: avatar slot (AVATAR_SLOTS: head, face, neck, torso, hands, legs, feet, back, accessory) → anchor

CharacterApose.description: The A-pose of a look (full body, neutral): the reader's avatar body with the wear anchors of the avatar slots.

AposeAnchor.description: Where an avatar item sits on an A-pose image: centre and size in px of that image.

image.description: CDN path from the CDN root

LookTransition.description: An image shown while a persona's look changes (the mouse taking her helmet off).
